component.name: System Assistant
component.summary: System maintenance and post-install setup utility

description.p: A native GTK 4 and Libadwaita utility to update system packages and Flatpaks, mute the hardware PC speaker module, and install essential desktop tools.

screenshot.caption: Main window showing system maintenance toggles

description.p: Added GNOME experience and battery tweaks, light/dark theme awareness, and Wayland thread-safety fixes:

ul.li: Added Touchpad Tap-to-Click, GNOME Night Light, and Top Bar Battery Percentage toggles
Included GNOME experience tweaks in the one-click Recommended preset
Automatically select light or dark adw-gtk3 theme based on system color scheme
Fixed Wayland thread safety for status refreshes and root privilege detection for GPU and gaming tasks

description.p: Added automatic GPU driver/VA-API setup, one-click presets, Gaming Essentials, and live task progress:

ul.li: Automatic GPU vendor detection with proprietary NVIDIA driver or open-source VA-API setup
One-click Recommended preset and Clear All buttons
Gaming Essentials toggle (Steam, GameMode, MangoHud, and ProtonUp-Qt)
Live task progress bar and refreshed application icon

description.p: Added live system status detection, clipboard log export, and Flathub branding metadata:

ul.li: Automatically detect already-installed apps and active system tweaks on startup
Improved GPU model parsing in the Overview tab
Added a one-click Copy Log button inside Task Output Log

description.p: Organized interface into dedicated tabs and added GNOME post-install tweaks:

ul.li: Added Overview, Maintenance, and Tweaks & Apps navigation tabs
Added native About window with developer info
Added RPM Fusion & multimedia codec setup, adw-gtk3 theme, and window titlebar button toggles

description.p: Added System Hardware summary card and storage cleanup tasks:

ul.li: Expandable System Hardware summary card (device, CPU, RAM, GPU)
Clear package manager cache and vacuum old systemd journal logs
